connect_token.title: Synapse Connect Token
connect_token.description: Your Synapse Connect Token. Get it at forge.synapselayer.org → Dashboard → Connect. Optional at config time; required only to call authenticated tools. Leave empty to browse and call public tools (e.g. health_check).

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: Identifier for the agent using the memory layer. Defaults to 'default'.

memory_scope.title: Memory Scope
memory_scope.description: Default scope for recall and search: 'agent' isolates to the current agent; 'tenant' searches across all agents. Optional.

max_recall_results.title: Max Recall Results
max_recall_results.description: Default maximum number of memories returned per recall query (1–50). Optional.
